_comment: Corrections to URLs as DOC exports them, applied at build time so they survive the next export. Matching ignores scheme, case and any trailing slash. 'replace' rewrites the link; 'remove' drops the site from the page entirely. Verified from outside the facility 2026-09-16.

g-wonlinetextbooks.com.note: Bare domain does not resolve; needs the www prefix. Verified 200.

ctclink.us.note: ctclink.us does not respond; gateway.ctclink.us is the real entry point. Verified 200.

ecasas.org.note: Needs www and does not support https. Reported from the facility; returns HTTP 500 from outside, so recheck from inside.

remove.app.boardworkseducation.com: Domain no longer exists (DNS NXDOMAIN); flagged for removal after facility testing.
remove.osibridge.com: Site expired - serves a Squarespace 'Website Expired' placeholder.
remove.lumion3d.net: Domain has no address record - nothing to reach. Was previously listed as an http-only override; --check-links showed getaddrinfo finds no A record for lumion3d.net or www.lumion3d.net (2026-09-16).
remove.cct-pearsonvue.com: Domain has no address record - only an MX record for mail, no web host. Confirmed dead from inside and outside the facility (2026-09-16).
